title: CobblemonPlus+
description: This is mainly a cobblemon pack, with a few extra mods to make life easier, or to have some fun with.
body:
This is a fun Cobblemon pack, built around catching, training, and battling Pokémon in a smooth, lightweight Minecraft experience that's made to be played with friends.
At its core is Cobblemon, the mod that brings Pokémon into your world with proper spawning, capturing, and battling. Around that, the pack focuses on two things: running well, and being fun in a group.
On the performance side, it includes a curated set of optimization mods so you can run higher render distances without your frames tanking. Sodium overhauls the rendering engine, Lithium speeds up the game's internals, Distant Horizons adds gorgeous long-distance terrain so you can actually see the world you're exploring, and a handful of supporting mods (FerriteCore, Krypton, C2ME, Noisium, and others) keep memory use and chunk loading tight. Whether you're on a beefy rig or something more modest, the goal is a buttery-smooth ride.
For the social side, the pack adds quality-of-life and multiplayer features that make playing together better. Chat Heads makes conversations easier to follow, and Carry On lets you pick up and move blocks and creatures with ease. From The Fog adds a touch of eerie atmosphere for those who like a scare, while AppleSkin and JEI round things out with handy info displays and a full recipe and item browser.
It's a relaxed, friend-focused Cobblemon adventure — easy to jump into, smooth to run, and built for good times together.
